aim: Does KRC typed planning improve Korean contextual naturalness and coherent, accurate expression over unchanged general LLM and surface-only anti-template instructions?

participant_protocol.consent: Voluntary reading/writing evaluation with no identifying details; readers may skip or abstain.
instruments: Show one of three counterbalanced 6-pair forms, one brief per pair.
Read the same factual brief and two anonymized texts.
Check factual grounding independently of prose preference.
Choose left/right/tie/abstain for Korean naturalness in context.
Rate each passage 1-7 for clarity and discourse flow, or skip.
Add short linguistic reasons (syntax, referents, cadence, overclaimed cause, voice).
participant_protocol.allocation: Three forms, 6 different source briefs per form, B/K B/A and K/A pairings balanced over forms.
participant_protocol.important: The forms use outputs from the same model but differ in prompt length/planning; reader judgments cannot establish pure typed-IR causal mediation.
participant_protocol.privacy: Do not collect real names, email, school affiliation or other identifying data; self-generated anonymous label optional.
participant_protocol.semantic_firewall: Readers who judge prose naturalness are not used as definitive semantic truth labels unless separately trained and blind to arms.

statistical_precommit.primary: On each brief, paired K/B naturalness win=1, tie=0.5, loss=0; report counts and uncertainty not significance without independent readers.
secondary: K/A and A/B pairwise contextual fit
statistical_precommit.unit: Participant × pair, cluster by both participant and brief if inferential model later defined
statistical_precommit.missing: No filled judgment is not a tie. Abstentions tracked as separate denominator.

failure_conditions: Any arm label visible in reader packet
Missing raw text erroneously filled with fake text
Critic heuristic treated as objective semantic quality
A sample output treated as a human-authored reference
